subject: english-literature
title: The Unreliable Witness
welcome_lead: Some narrators lie. Can you spot the cracks in their story?
meta_desc: KS3 English Literature adventure on narrator reliability and viewpoint.
final_note: You can now judge whether a narrator is to be trusted.

concepts.def: A narrator who distorts the truth.
The angle from which a story is told.

walkthroughs.body_html: In The Curious Incident of the Dog in the Night-Time, Christopher tells the story but his view is limited by his understanding of others. Clues like contradictions or gaps signal unreliability.
An omniscient narrator zooms between minds; a limited narrator stays with one character, so we learn only what they learn.
Spot 1st person by the 'I' pronouns. Spot 3rd person by 'he/she/they'. The pronoun changes how close we feel to the character.

options: A sonnet is any short love poem.
